published_source: SYNTHETIC DATA. Authors' replication_public.Rmd felm call re-run on the shipped public_dataset.csv, which the README describes as a synthetic substitute for NDA data (10,000 synthetic households, white noise added). The authors' own HTML output on the same synthetic data prints 0.225 (0.005). The article's actual coefficients are unknown (no article text in the project).
notes: Rmd 'Table 1' column 4, outcome consent flag: service-use data, end of month. felm(y ~ treated + factor(month_id) | id | 0 | id). Household-month panel Jan-Oct 2018, 10,000 synthetic households x 10 months = 100,000 rows. Two adoption cohorts, no never-treated units: 'Treated' group first treated 201807 (4,988 households), 'Control' group first treated 201808 (5,012). Treatment absorbing. fixest feols(y ~ treated | id + month_id, cluster = ~id) reproduces the felm output to machine precision. Results must be reported separately from the main analysis unless the authors provide the real data.
